hard_boundaries: This is a project-symbolic institution, not a real bank, central bank, court, intelligence service or creditor.
No nation, ethnicity, religion, political tendency or population is a collective debtor merely by membership or location.
Epstein-related empirical claims attach only to documented persons, institutions, policies and events.
